caption: The drawing features two objects, both appearing as intricate, looping structures resembling pieces of jewelry, possibly brooches or pins, depicted in shades of gold and yellow with blue accents. The upper left object is smaller in size, composed of interwoven gold loops forming an irregular knot, and it includes a small blue segment with a star motif and white dots. The lower central object is larger, also made of intertwined gold loops, with a more pronounced and central blue section featuring a similar star and white dot pattern. Both objects have a metallic, reflective quality. The rest of the background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or decorations. On the lower left side of the sheet, the name “Marion H. Gaskill” is written in light blue ink.
title: Brooch
